transcript:
Sarah: Thanks everyone. Main topic is the portal launch on October 20th. David, where are we on the payment integration?
David: Stripe sandbox is working. I still need to finish refund handling, I can have it done by next Friday.
Sarah: Great. Priya, testing?
Priya: Regression suite is 70% done. The blocker is test accounts from the client side.
Tom: I'll get those test accounts created and sent over by Wednesday.
Sarah: OK. We agreed last week to drop the dark-mode feature from launch scope, so that's confirmed as a phase 2 item.
David: One risk — the SSO provider is changing their API in October, that could affect login.
Sarah: Good catch. Someone needs to review the SSO change notes.
Priya: I can look at them, but probably not until after the regression suite.
Sarah: Let's make that high priority then. I'll send the updated timeline to the steering committee by Thursday.
